subject: learning/standalone-doc-proposal-base
statement: The document pre-push gate must use the same supplied proposal base as shared and hosted gates, and must return failure when output cannot be written.
rationale: A stacked document PR otherwise includes its parent implementation in the standalone range. Explicit merge-base flags take precedence over PYXIS_CI_BASE, which precedes configured mainline; an unavailable selected ref remains an error. Independent installed repository fixtures clear the foreign outer base. Failed stdout writes and defect-report closes must not be reported as success.
